name: Hangzhou Coco Healthcare Products Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Coco Healthcare Products Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the innovation, manufacturing, and distribution of products across three main categories: baby care, adult incontinence, and pet hygiene. Its extensive portfolio of adult incontinence solutions features items such as adult diapers, pull-up pants, nursing pads, maternity towels, and menstrual pants, alongside a variety of general absorbent towels and specialized absorbent pads for men. Established in 2001, the company was initially known as Hangzhou Qiaozi Paper Industry Co.,Ltd. before adopting its current name, Hangzhou Coco Healthcare Products Co.,Ltd., in December 2011. Its operations are based in Hangzhou, China.
